datasets.title: MNase hypersensitive regions
datasets.description: Open chromatin regions in the maize genome, found with a differential nuclease sensitivity assay based on micrococcal nuclease (MNase) digestion of root and shoot tissue from seedlings. Files are in BED format with three columns: chromosome, start, and end. Coordinates are 0-based and end-exclusive.
datasets.citation: Rodgers-Melnick E, Vera DL, Bass HW, Buckler ES. 2016. [Open chromatin reveals the functional maize genome. *PNAS* 113(22):E3177–E3184](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/27185945)
datasets.notice: The processed BED files were hosted on the CyVerse Discovery Environment, and those links no longer work. Raw reads are still on NCBI SRA; email [qisun@cornell.edu](mailto:qisun@cornell.edu) for the processed files.
